c3Observation.finding: C3's own reason string is 'internal consistency'. Both leaves (landUseFact.landUseCode and baseFacts.landUse) come from one facets payload from one upstream. One party acting alone produces both sides. That is the same vacuity family zero named, one layer out (payload-internal, not caller-flag-internal). It is not two independently derived sources. Observation only; C3 is not rewritten on this card. The fix is LDT #566 plus the Wave R bake.
c3Observation.rejectedAlternative: treat C3 as S3's second derivation by splitting one payload into two named sources; rejected because that fabricates independence
